_comments: INHERITED IsA FOREIGN KEYS, whose RelatedEntityID CodeGen cannot derive.
CodeGen reads RelatedEntityID from FOREIGN KEY CONSTRAINTS ON THE BASE TABLE. In
Table-Per-Type the child table holds only its own columns -- __mj_BizAppsSales.SalesAccount
has five FKs and none of them is for an inherited column, because those columns are not on
the table. They reach the child through vwSalesAccounts. There is no constraint to read, so
the relationship comes back NULL and the generated form omits LinkType="Record".
WHAT THAT COSTS, and it is not cosmetic: without LinkType the control is a plain text input,
so form-field's OnInputChange does `this.Value = input.value` -- and a native input's value is
ALWAYS a string. An empty field writes '' rather than null, '' is not a null against a
uniqueidentifier, and creating a Sales Account fails with
Conversion failed when converting from a character string to uniqueidentifier
on the PARENT entity save, naming neither the field nor the form.
The correlation was measured and is exception-free: every column physically on the child
table carries RelatedEntityID; every inherited one does not.
IncludeRelatedEntityNameFieldInBaseView IS PINNED FALSE TOO, and that pin is the load-bearing
one. RelatedEntityNameFieldMap names a joined display column -- OrganizationType, Parent,
LinkedUser -- that the PARENT view has and the CHILD view does NOT. The map is harmless as a
lookup (form-field falls through to GetEntityRecordName when the column is absent), but if a
later CodeGen ever flipped this flag to match what AccountTypeID does, it would regenerate
vwSalesAccounts with three joined columns and NO matching EntityField rows. That is KI-7's
signature exactly -- 'Column name or number of supplied values does not match table
definition' on every insert, the same shape as vwOrderLines at 41 columns against 39
registered fields. Pinned false so the hazard cannot open.
AutoUpdateRelatedEntityInfo GOES TO 0 for the same reason .deal-field-labels.json sets
AutoUpdateDisplayName false -- so the next CodeGen run cannot re-derive NULL over these rows
and silently reopen the bug. Values are copied from the parent entity's own field, so a child
resolves exactly what the parent does.
Upstream: MemberJunction/MJ#4569 (CodeGen should carry the parent's FK metadata to IsA
children) and MJ#4570 (form-field should coerce '' to null for uniqueidentifier). This file
can be deleted once 4569 lands and a regenerate confirms the rows come back populated.
See bizapps-sales#90.
Self-referencing: an account's parent organization. This is the one that LOOKED fine in the
reported failure -- it passed NULL correctly via @ParentID_Clear=1 -- but only because no
panel rendered it. Identical defect, one rendered field away from the same error.
Sales Contacts is the IsA child of common's People, and carries the same shape.
